mapper.sql: paper_id, paper_name, paper_type, stage, grade, total_score, status, create_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper_info (paper_id, paper_name, paper_type, stage, grade, total_score, status, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{paperName}, #{paperType}, #{stage}, #{grade}, #{totalScore}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT group_id, paper_id, group_name, group_sort, create_time FROM paper_group WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY group_sort ASC, group_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper_group (group_id, paper_id, group_name, group_sort, create_time) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{paperId}, #{groupName}, #{groupSort}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, paper_id, group_id, question_id, score, sort, create_time FROM paper_question WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY group_id ASC, sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper_question (paper_id, group_id, question_id, score, sort, create_time) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{groupId}, #{questionId}, #{score}, #{sort}, #{createTime})
